_readme: Two lists of keys that are NOT valid rows in aircraft-types.json. `pseudo`: markers ADS-B feeds put in the type field when they do not know the type (readsb/tar1090 source tags). `dumpAliases`: family or marketing keys inherited from an older dataset, mapped to the DOC 8643 designator a transponder actually sends (null = no real designator exists, e.g. a cancelled variant). A pull request that adds a row under any of these keys is rejected by scripts/validate.mjs. Mirrors PSEUDO_TYPE_CODES and DUMP_ALIAS_TYPES in the Skydex application; drift fails the publish.
